visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair is lying in bed, wearing a black t-shirt and leaning against a grey headboard with pink pillows. He scrolls on a smartphone with a concentrated expression before smiling broadly and dramatically ripping off his shirt as a stylized orange and yellow flame graphic overlays the center of the frame against a bright indoor bedroom backdrop. (2) The scene abruptly cuts to a static black-and-white portrait of the man looking disheveled with simulated bruises and cuts on his face. This portrait is held in a white picture frame and surrounded by white funeral chrysanthemums, creating a humorous 'failed' narrative beat before reverting back to the main scene. (3) The man is standing in a hallway by a white door with a silver handle; he is wearing a black shirt. After hearing a voice, he turns around and repeats the exaggerated shirt-stripping action as large comic flames erupt around his torso in a high-arousal performance while he dances toward the camera. (4) The funeral frame motif reappears as a short intercut, showing the same monochrome portrait with bruised makeup and white flowers. (5) The man sits on a grey sofa in a living room, holding a grey insulated tumbler and his smartphone. He looks confused and then lunges forward toward the lens with an aggressive, humorous facial expression as fire graphics consume the screen once more. (6) The funeral frame intercut is displayed again for a brief moment. (7) The visual shifts to a screen-recording sequence of the Shopee mobile shopping application, showcasing products like a 15g gold bar and a sleep mask. The man's face appears in a circular picture-in-picture overlay at the top left, reacting to the products shown on the interface. (8) Back on the grey sofa, the man holds his phone to his ear, listening to a voice message with a contemplative and slightly worried expression against a white curtain background decorated with heart patterns. (9) The man stands in a white hallway, holding his phone toward the camera and speaking directly to the viewer. He wears a black shirt and a smartwatch; text overlays about the Shopee affiliate program and a '3%' commission rate appear as he points to his device screen in a promotional manner.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, energetic pop music bed. A soft female voice speaks casually, followed by a male voice that quickly transitions from a low, inquisitive tone to a loud, high-pitched comedic shout with high arousal as he reacts to the visual flames. (2) A sharp 'thud' sound effect accompanies a sudden cut to a somber, low-frequency orchestral stinger that mimics a funeral atmosphere, providing a stark contrast to the previous energetic music. (3) The bright pop BGM resumes alongside a female voice asking for pajamas. The male speaker responds with an enthusiastic tone, followed by a 'whoosh' sound effect and another high-pitched, exaggerated shout as the music swells in volume. (4) The somber funeral chime and low-energy musical bed repeat briefly, punctuating the comedic failure. (5) Fast-paced conversational dialogue occurs between a nagging female voice and the man; a cartoonish 'pop' and 'sizzle' sound effect play as he lunges, ending with the recurring somber memorial theme. (6) The audio transitions into a steady, informative narration by the male speaker over a light, upbeat synth-pop track. Clean 'click' and 'scroll' sound effects are audible, synchronizing with the screen recording of the app. (7) The final phase features professional, enunciated speech from the male narrator as he explains the affiliate program. The BGM remains consistent and upbeat, concluding with a light melodic stinger that signifies the end of the presentation.
